method: Valved brass is modelled as the harmonic series of the open tube plus valve tubing that lowers the whole series. The traditional just-intonation layout puts the first valve at 1/8 of the main tube, the second at 1/15 and the third at 1/5, which lowers the series by 203.9, 111.7 and 315.6 cents; a combination adds the lengths rather than the intervals, so its pitch factor is 1/(1+sum) and 1-2 comes to 303.6 cents, 2-3 to 409.2, 1-3 to 487.2 and 1-2-3 to 572.2, which is why 1-2 is not the note of 3 and why 1-3 and 1-2-3 are sharp of a true fourth and tritone. For a written note the page lists every combination and every harmonic whose pitch lands within 50 cents of that note, with the deviation in cents from 12-tone equal temperament at A4 = 440 Hz, sorted by absolute deviation so the two ways to play one pitch class sit side by side, and ties are broken by harmonic then by valve name. Harmonics run from 2 to 8, because the page works in written pitch where the pedal is C3 on all four instruments in the list (Bb trumpet, Bb cornet, Bb flugelhorn, F horn), so one fingering table covers all of them and the instrument only changes what the note sounds like: a Bb instrument sounds a major second below its written pitch and the F horn a perfect fifth below. The second table prints the open series, harmonics 2 to 8, as a written note, a sounding note and a deviation from equal temperament, which is where the 13.7 cents flat fifth harmonic and the 31.2 cents flat seventh harmonic of a just series show up. Cents are produced - target, so a negative figure is flat, and the same pitch can appear twice when a valve lands a higher harmonic on a lower one, as the third valve on the sixth harmonic is the open fifth. Only the plain three-valve layout is modelled: no fourth valve, no compensating system, no trigger, throw, slide pull or hand-stopped note, and no alternative crooks or instrument keys, and the page does not pick a fingering for the player because charts, slide pulls and the player's ear decide that. A note is read as a letter A to G, an optional sharp or flat and an octave from 0 to 8, a written range of F#3 to C6 follows from the layout and is refused outside it rather than guessed, and everything runs in the browser with no storage, uploads or network requests.

sources.title: Brass instrument - valve combination table: the three-valve layout lowers the series by 2, 1 and 3 half-steps, the traditional just-intonation tubing of 1/8, 1/15 and 1/5 of the main tube, and every combination's ratio and cents from 12-tone equal temperament
Harmonic series (music) - the harmonics are the positive integer multiples of the fundamental, f, 2f, 3f and so on, and the difference between each harmonic and equal temperament is measured in cents
